dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: Helka's in Liyue. If only I could go there with her...

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: She's my friend, but she's gone on a journey far, far away. She said she'll come back once she collects information on 100 monster varieties... But who knows how long that will take?

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: I'm not as strong as her, going off on her own to faraway places. All I can do is stay here and wait...

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: She's sent me loads of pictures and postcards, though — she gets the merchants to deliver them. She even sent me a monster handbook to look at!

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: Yeah. Katya's been so good to me, but the only way I can repay her is by doing a few simple chores...

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: If only I were as capable as Helka, I could help Katya out in all sorts of ways.

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: You're leaving? Have a safe journey!
